We're here to help

Need a hand?

If a download does not start, check that your browser allows new tabs and that the download link is still accessible. For setup or access issues, contact the site owner.

Frequently asked questions

Why are some downloads locked?

Those platform builds have not been supplied yet. Add the relevant package links before enabling those buttons.

Why did the email notification fail?

Email notifications require a valid EmailJS service ID, template ID, and public key. The template ID in the script must be replaced with your actual EmailJS template ID.

Where does the download come from?

The enabled Windows download opens the Google Drive link configured in this page.
